name: yosys
readme_excerpt: yosys – Yosys Open SYnthesis Suite This is a framework for RTL synthesis tools. It currently has extensive Verilog-2005 support and provides a basic set of synthesis algorithms for various application domains. Yosys is using sv-elab and slang libraries to provide comprehensive SystemVerilog support. It supports an (informally defined) synthesizable subset of SystemVerilog in version IEEE 1800-2017 or IEEE 1800-2023.
